prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE unified landscape 3-by-2 art-direction contact sheet for the Gym-Beam workout app. Audience: ADULTS, nostalgic action-movie, science-fiction and game fans, with dry gym humour. Create SIX original affectionate gym reinterpretations of recognizable screen characters. Important art direction: mature arcade PIXEL ART with believable ADULT human proportions around six and a half heads high, normal SMALL eyes, defined noses and jaws, adult facial features, restrained expressions, age lines or stubble where appropriate. NOT chibi, NOT cute, NOT Disney, NOT anime faces, NOT teenagers, NOT a children's game or a toy sticker pack. Use crisp deliberately stepped pixel clusters, a consistent dark outline, three shade values per material, same three-quarter view and upper-left light for all six. Do not use high-resolution painted skin, airbrush, glossy 3D rendering, smooth gradients, noisy dithering or a pixelation filter over a painting. Vary physiques naturally: trained adults, not all bodybuilders, no body-shaming. Same framing and actual body height across cells, full figures and every prop in frame; strong legible silhouettes. Flat neutral graphite background #111315, unframed composition, no cards, a little clear breathing room between figures, no scenery, particles, glow or giant decorative effects. Red, turquoise, olive, yellow, blue workwear and steel give the cast varied but coherent colors. SIX figures only. TOP LEFT label exactly 'РОККИ НА РАЙОНЕ': a mature thirty-something Italian-American boxer with dark curly hair, a defined nose and slight stubble, grey hooded training sweats, red gloves and a plain towel. Calm weary half-smile after a real training session, not a baby-faced cartoon boxer. TOP CENTER label exactly 'САРА У СТОЙКИ': a mature athletic blonde woman in her thirties/forties, tied-back hair, olive training tank, charcoal trousers, sunglasses pushed onto her head. She studies tomorrow's workout on a small clipboard with the serious planning expression of Sarah Connor, no guns. TOP RIGHT label exactly 'ЛАРА ЗА БЛИНАМИ': an adult athletic explorer with long dark braid, turquoise training top, practical loose brown shorts and trainers, a small backpack. Triumphantly holds a recognizable barbell spring collar with coil and two loop handles like a priceless artifact. Natural adult anatomy and small eyes, not pinup, no guns or holsters. BOTTOM LEFT label exactly 'БРЮС ЖИМ': a mature lean martial artist inspired by Bruce Lee, sharp adult face, straight short black hair, yellow training suit with black stripes. Holds two small weight plates instead of action-movie weapons, balanced relaxed stance, a dry raised eyebrow, no fighting effects. BOTTOM CENTER label exactly 'РИПЛИ НА СМЕНЕ': a capable mature woman in her thirties/forties with dark curly hair, square adult face, blue-grey industrial coverall with sleeves rolled up, simple trainers. A single compact yellow industrial lifting gauntlet on one forearm delicately holds a tiny weight plate, an oversized-machine-for-a-small-task gym joke; practical, resourceful Ellen Ripley spirit, no alien, no weapon. BOTTOM RIGHT label exactly 'ТЕРМИНАТОР ПОДХОДОВ': broad mature adult man with squared brown haircut, angular older face, black training tank, dark trousers, sunglasses and one simple cool-steel mechanical arm. He is comically waiting on a round red-black rest stopwatch held in his human hand while the mechanical hand grips one end of a short loaded barbell. No gun, blood, intimidating horror or extra limbs. Place each exact Russian label UNDER its figure, clean compact light pixel lettering, wrap onto two lines when necessary. Add a small header at top exactly 'GYM-BEAM / УРОВНИ'. No other text, captions, logos or watermarks. The visual humor should come from an adult movie character's personality meeting ordinary gym logistics, not a childish caricature or imitation of Punch Club assets.
